record.question: Which of the following India city is known as 'Manchester of India'?
record.explanation: Answer A: Ahmedabad. Ahmedabad is conventionally known as the Manchester of India because of its textile industry. Ahmedabad District’s original history explicitly records that nickname. Historical/source note: Historical textile-industry epithet, not an assertion that the name has never been applied to another Indian industrial city. Reference: https://ahmedabad.nic.in/history/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
